title: Three Little Kittens
summary: Three little kittens are scared of the neighborhood dog. He only wants to play with them, but every time they see him they run away! Why are they so afraid of him?
pages: One day three little kittens meet a big dog.
The kittens are scared of the dog.
The little kittens run fast, and even faster!
The little kittens bump into a little bird.
But the little kittens keep running.
The little kittens bump into a little boy.
But the little kittens keep running.
They run onto a long wooden pier.
"Oh no! Now we're in trouble." "Help! Help!" they shout.
The dog comes running up to them, smiling. "I'm so happy to run with you!" he says.
What a surprise! Now the little kittens have a new friend.
